title: answering to my previous post about biotech ideas
text:
so in the previous post i laid out my framework for how to come up with an idea. 
((basically said find a unique way to sell to pharma and AI labs in a way you think is cool and fits a broader mission)) now if i want to proceed i need to think about how i will answer that. 

but broadly, what i care about is human enhancement ((i should come up with a thesis around why its a net good for society and not just be like oh it seems cool))

((i want to explore about how to integrate blockchain since i have an intution about it from https://bioacc.life/))

actually,  i think i just need to talk to people. but think about how to do so in a maximally productive way. but not just because thats what everyone says to do, its more finding as, as Peter Thiel put it,  a secret that forms the basis of a company.  ((Peter Thiel’s view on secrets is a core philosophy detailed in his book Zero to One. Rather than gossip or hidden trivia, Thiel defines a secret as an important, fundamental truth about the world that is currently unrecognized or unappreciated by most people.))

okay lets start with what i want and how talking to people will get me what i want:
- fundamentally, I want to understand what AI labs, pharma, the government, etc. will buy so that i can get LOI from them, create a v1 here at cornell and then seek investment on those grounds
- fuck, i dont know anyone at those places

((Even though I haven't read 0 to 1 i watched some Peter Thiel videos where he discusses some of the ideas and i think i need to spend a lot more time thinking through how i can apply his philosophy. not just because its Peter Thiel yay so smart  let me blindly adapt his philosophy. its more like what i am aiming for is a generational company and thats what he discusses. ))

I wanted to start this is ground myself intellectually. I have realized that I am more driven by hype as of now, which is a fine place to start, but I think there needs to be honest pursuit of truth thereafter. I want to pursue truth of crazy ideas with the energy that comes with the excitement . . . i have to close my laptop for class ill complete this later

taking a stance on e/acc and equivalent movements ie bio/acc and inspiration for starting to write online. 

my initial intuition is to hop on the ideology. and, as of now, without fully thinking through them to become fully defenceable, i use them for their utility: the energy i get from the ideas of rapid tech growth that i use to dive deeper into the subject. but what ive found with myself is that i become excited by something like bio/acc, but i need to carry out thinking it through to be able to take an intellectually honest stance. 

and i also started it as well as being inspired to write more after reading thru some of https://www.maxxyung.com/ and realized I a) what to become more defensible in what i see truth to be b) become more discoverable like how i found maxx
Made myself a website tonight. Notes like this one are for short stuff (a thought, a quote, a link) that doesn't need to be a whole post.
